name: apple-apps
description: Connect Apple apps to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Apple apps MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Apple apps to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with mail, Calendar and more on your Mac using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Apple apps workspace.
Find anything in Apple apps that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review mail, Calendar and more on your Mac in Apple apps.
